api.scope: One controlled additive migration from schema 27 to 28 and API container replacement; previous business data, database identity, PostgreSQL, proxy, configuration, integration flags, timers and infrastructure preserved.

verification.backend_build: Release build without errors or warnings
verification.local_oci_smoke: Pinned linux/amd64 artifact passed against isolated PostgreSQL 18: 28 migrations, no seed, readiness/authentication, material history and cleanup verified.
verification.source_ci_checks: Source CI and the Production workflow quality and owner review passed for source_commit. Workflow image publication does not itself deploy the VM or Firebase.
verification.production_health: API, PostgreSQL and proxy healthy; readiness HTTPS 200 and unauthenticated auth/me 401, with verified TLS.

recovery.bootstrap_metadata_and_terraform_image_p: Historical migration preparation pin, intentionally unchanged. Use the current api.image and review the current schema for recovery; do not reapply historical infrastructure or restart all containers for an application release.
recovery.rollback: A WEB-only return retains the protected new API and schema 28. Never restart the old API with incompatible material writers enabled. API failure requires maintenance and a reviewed compatible correction; preserve all history, never run Down or restore over the active database.
